files.rsvp/README.md:
# RSVP exports

One file per invitation wave, tab separated: time, event, reply, guest.
When filtering, match `event` and `reply` on the whole cell value, not by prefix or substring.
Field order is fixed (awk column numbers): $1 time, $2 event, $3 reply, $4 guest. All files share the same layout, the first line is a header, with no blank lines and no stray spaces.
